__comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the search API's envelope. The real payload carries some fifty
fields per entry; the four this theme reads are here, plus the cursor keys
the envelope always has, because the fingerprint keys on them.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- the entries span three content ratings, so the maxContentRating filter
has something to do. It is applied to the *response* rather than sent
as a query parameter: the endpoint accepts a parameter of that name but
its semantics are undocumented, and guessing wrong would drop results
silently. Filtering what came back cannot.
- one entry carries no rating at all, and must be kept: refusing to show
something because the site forgot to classify it is the wrong way round
- one entry has no slug and must be skipped rather than yielding an ID
that resolves to the listing root
- one title is padded by the serialiser
**Slashes are escaped, and that is the point.** The server's JSON encoder
escapes forward slashes, so the bytes on the wire read `api\/search`, not
`api/search`. The first version of this fixture wrote them unescaped — an
invented form that then confirmed itself, exactly as PLAN §9 describes: a
path signal scored 15 here and 0 on the real response. Corrected and
measured 2026-09-16.
Why synthetic: PLAN §1.3 forbids this repository from containing a real
aggregator's domain or content, and §1.4 forbids copying anyone's
expression. The response *shape* is an observable fact; the words, the
identifiers and the host are ours. Host is example.invalid (RFC 2606).
